name: All Items by OPNiki
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: OPNiki
description: Collect every item in the game, one at a time, in random order. Automatic detection, an overview grid, and a skip command for anything unobtainable.
works: A client challenge, /challenge start [seed], that picks every item in random order and shows the current one in a panel at the top centre of the HUD (name, number, total); collecting it moves on, /challenge skip skips it.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet: The overview grid (/challenge list) is its own screen, which Kiln doesn't open; the item icon in the panel is drawn with GuiGraphicsExtractor.item and may not show; the mod works without it
